# Cherrywood Housing Budget — 2028

**Applicable lease:** December 1, 2027–November 30, 2028. This is the countersigned renewal active at the start of 2028. Prior lease terms are not included.

## Recurring monthly lease charges

| Charge | Monthly |
|---|---:|
| Base rent | $2,660 |
| Parking | $75 |
| Kibo pet rent | $25 |
| Trash | $20 |
| **Household monthly total** | **$2,780** |

**Equal monthly household transfer:** $1,390 per person (two people; $2,780 total).

## Annualized totals

| Total | Household | Per person |
|---|---:|---:|
| 12-month total | $33,360 | $16,680 |

**Renewal-processing fee:** None; no fee is included in the monthly or annual totals.

These figures cover the listed recurring lease charges only; variable utilities and other non-lease expenses are not included.
